nodes.name: Website Webhook
nodes.notes: Receives POST from script.js on every email signup and contact form submission. URL: https://dfnworldwide.app.n8n.cloud/webhook/dfn-subscriber — copy this URL into DFN.n8nWebhook in script.js.

nodes.name: Normalize Data
nodes.notes: Parses and cleans the incoming payload from either the email capture forms (hero/join) or the full contact form. Produces a consistent shape for downstream nodes.

nodes.name: Subscriber or Contact?
nodes.notes: Splits the flow: newsletter subscribers go to the CRM + welcome sequence; contact form submissions go to the CRM + direct notification only (no welcome email).

nodes.name: Google Sheets — Add Subscriber
nodes.notes: Requires Google Sheets OAuth2 credential. Create a sheet with a 'Subscribers' tab and columns: Timestamp, Name, Email, Source, Type. Replace REPLACE_WITH_YOUR_GOOGLE_SHEET_ID with your actual Sheet ID from the URL.

nodes.name: Brevo — Add Contact + Trigger Welcome
nodes.notes: Requires an HTTP Header Auth credential with header name 'api-key' and your Brevo API key as the value. Adding a contact to a list with an active Brevo automation attached will auto-trigger your 3-email welcome sequence. Replace REPLACE_WITH_YOUR_BREVO_LIST_ID with your list's numeric ID (found in Brevo under Contacts > Lists).

nodes.name: Google Sheets — Add Enquiry
nodes.notes: Logs press, sponsorship, book, and general enquiries to a separate 'Contact Enquiries' tab in the same spreadsheet so subscriber growth and business enquiries stay easy to report on separately.

parameters.subject: =New DFN Enquiry: {{ $json.enquiryType }} — {{ $json.name }}

nodes.name: Email — Notify DFN Team
nodes.notes: Sends an immediate email to dfnworldwide@gmail.com for every contact form submission so nothing sits unread in Brevo/Sheets alone. Requires SMTP credentials (Gmail App Password works well here).

nodes.name: Respond to Website
nodes.notes: Returns a JSON success response to the fetch() call in script.js. The website already treats this as fire-and-forget, so a failure here will not block the user experience.
